newsitem.title: CANADA: AT Plastics sees Q4 profit cut by C$1.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: AT Plastics sees Q4 profit cut by C$1.5 mln.

text.p: AT Plastics Inc said on Thursday that problems affecting its Polymers business will negatively affect fourth quarter earnings by about C$1.5 million.

AT Plastics said in a statement said the operating problems were related to longer-than-planned maintenance. In addition, polymer production at its Edmonton plant was lost due to a burst underground cooling water main.
AT Plastics said the plant is now back in full production.
